\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{দুর্যোগ} (durjog)}{দুর্যোগ (durjog)}]{\bn{দুর্যোগ} (durjog) — a natural disaster}

\label{lesson:BN-C538-durjog}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a commitment, then the Bengali for to shrink back.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{দুর্যোগ}}
\textbf{\bn{দুর্যোগ}} — \emph{durjog} — \textquotedblleft{}a natural disaster\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{দুর্যোগ} \bn{হলে} \bn{আমরা} \bn{স্কুলে} \bn{আশ্রয়} \bn{নেব।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Durjog hôle āmrā skule āshrôy nebô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If disaster strikes, we will take shelter in the school.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{দুর্যোগ}} (\emph{durjog}) is Sanskrit \emph{duryoga}, \textquotedblleft{}a bad contrivance\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams): \emph{dur-}, \textquotedblleft{}bad\textquotedblright{}, and \emph{yoga}, \textquotedblleft{}joining\textquotedblright{}; the sense \textquotedblleft{}a natural disaster\textquotedblright{} is the modern language's own.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{durjog}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{durjog}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Durjog hôle āmrā skule āshrôy nebô.} — If disaster strikes, we will take shelter in the school.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a commitment, then the Bengali for to shrink back, then say \emph{durjog} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{দুর্যোগ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A natural disaster\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{বিপর্যয়} (bipôrjôy)}{বিপর্যয় (bipôrjôy)}]{\bn{বিপর্যয়} (bipôrjôy) — a disaster; a calamity}

\label{lesson:BN-C538-biporjoy}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for to shrink back, then the Bengali for a natural disaster.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{বিপর্যয়}}
\textbf{\bn{বিপর্যয়}} — \emph{bipôrjôy} — \textquotedblleft{}a disaster; a calamity\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{বন্যা} \bn{হলে} \bn{গ্রামে} \bn{বড়} \bn{বিপর্যয়} \bn{হবে।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Bônyā hôle grāme bôṛo bipôrjôy hôbe.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If there is a flood, it will be a great calamity for the village.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{বিপর্যয়}} (\emph{bipôrjôy}) is Sanskrit \emph{viparyaya}, \textquotedblleft{}reversed, turned the wrong way\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams): everything turned upside down.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bipôrjôy}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bipôrjôy}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Bônyā hôle grāme bôṛo bipôrjôy hôbe.} — If there is a flood, it will be a great calamity for the village.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for to shrink back, then the Bengali for a natural disaster, then say \emph{bipôrjôy} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{বিপর্যয়} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A disaster; a calamity\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{উপক্রম} (upôkrôm)}{উপক্রম (upôkrôm)}]{\bn{উপক্রম} (upôkrôm) — being on the point of (something)}

\label{lesson:BN-C538-upokrom}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a natural disaster, then the Bengali for a calamity.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{উপক্রম}}
\textbf{\bn{উপক্রম}} — \emph{upôkrôm} — \textquotedblleft{}being on the point of (something)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{আকাশ} \bn{কালো}, \bn{বৃষ্টি} \bn{নামার} \bn{উপক্রম।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Ākāsh kālo, brishṭi nāmār upôkrôm.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The sky is black; it's about to rain.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{উপক্রম}} (\emph{upôkrôm}) is a tatsama, Sanskrit \emph{upakrama}, \textquotedblleft{}approach, setting about something\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{upôkrôm}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{upôkrôm}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Ākāsh kālo, brishṭi nāmār upôkrôm.} — The sky is black; it's about to rain.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a natural disaster, then the Bengali for a calamity, then say \emph{upôkrôm} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{উপক্রম} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Being on the point of (something)\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{আসন্ন} (āsônnô)}{আসন্ন (āsônnô)}]{\bn{আসন্ন} (āsônnô) — imminent; close at hand}

\label{lesson:BN-C538-asonno}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a calamity, then the Bengali for on the point of.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{আসন্ন}}
\textbf{\bn{আসন্ন}} — \emph{āsônnô} — \textquotedblleft{}imminent; close at hand\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{আসন্ন} \bn{ঝড়ের} \bn{জন্য} \bn{নৌকাগুলো} \bn{ঘাটে} \bn{ফিরল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Āsônnô jhôṛer jônyô noukāgulo ghāṭe phirlô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Because of the coming storm the boats returned to the landing.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{আসন্ন}} (\emph{āsônnô}) is a tatsama, Sanskrit \emph{āsanna}, \textquotedblleft{}set down near, close at hand\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{āsônnô}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{āsônnô}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Āsônnô jhôṛer jônyô noukāgulo ghāṭe phirlô.} — Because of the coming storm the boats returned to the landing.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a calamity, then the Bengali for on the point of, then say \emph{āsônnô} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{আপৎকালীন} (āpôtkālīn)}{আপৎকালীন (āpôtkālīn)}]{\bn{আপৎকালীন} (āpôtkālīn) — for emergencies; emergency}

\label{lesson:BN-C538-apotkalin}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for on the point of, then the Bengali for imminent.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{আপৎকালীন}}
\textbf{\bn{আপৎকালীন}} — \emph{āpôtkālīn} — \textquotedblleft{}for emergencies; emergency\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{এটা} \bn{হাসপাতালের} \bn{আপৎকালীন} \bn{দরজা।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Eṭā hāspātāler āpôtkālīn dôrjā.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
This is the hospital's emergency door.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{আপৎকালীন}} (\emph{āpôtkālīn}) is built on Sanskrit \emph{āpatkāla}, \textquotedblleft{}a time of misfortune\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams), with the ending \emph{-īna}, \textquotedblleft{}belonging to\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Eṭā hāspātāler āpôtkālīn dôrjā.} — This is the hospital's emergency door.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for on the point of, then the Bengali for imminent, then say \emph{āpôtkālīn} again

\section[(dialogue)]{Looking back: from What Lies Ahead to Close Calls}

\label{lesson:BN-R538-review-532-538}



\begin{quote}
Say the Bengali for destiny and what is bound to happen.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item destiny, what is bound to happen, to sense trouble coming, a forecast, an astrologer
  \item by chance, coincidental, a lucky break, to slip away, a lottery
  \item to bet, gambling, a coin toss, auspicious, to come true
  \item a seat belt, insurance, a guarantee, well protected, a fire extinguisher
  \item a recommendation, consent, a kind of thing, a style, to fit
  \item to make up one's mind, with no other choice, half-willing, a commitment, to shrink back
  \item a natural disaster, a calamity, on the point of, imminent, for emergencies
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Destiny? (\textbf{\bn{নিয়তি}}, \emph{niyôti}.) What is bound to happen? (\textbf{\bn{ভবিতব্য}}, \emph{bhôbitôbyô}.) To sense trouble coming? (\textbf{\bn{আঁচ} \bn{করা}}, \emph{ā̃ch kôrā}.) A forecast? (\textbf{\bn{পূর্বাভাস}}, \emph{pūrbābhās}.) An astrologer? (\textbf{\bn{জ্যোতিষী}}, \emph{jyotishī}.) By chance? (\textbf{\bn{দৈবাৎ}}, \emph{doibāt}.) Coincidental? (\textbf{\bn{কাকতালীয়}}, \emph{kāktālīyô}.) A lucky break? (\textbf{\bn{মওকা}}, \emph{môokā}.) To slip away? (\textbf{\bn{ফসকানো}}, \emph{phôskāno}.) A lottery? (\textbf{\bn{লটারি}}, \emph{lôṭāri}.) To bet? (\textbf{\bn{বাজি} \bn{ধরা}}, \emph{bāji dhôrā}.) Gambling? (\textbf{\bn{জুয়া}}, \emph{juyā}.) A coin toss? (\textbf{\bn{টস}}, \emph{ṭôs}.) Auspicious? (\textbf{\bn{শুভ}}, \emph{shubhô}.) To come true? (\textbf{\bn{ফলা}}, \emph{phôlā}.) A seat belt? (\textbf{\bn{সিটবেল্ট}}, \emph{siṭbelṭ}.) Insurance? (\textbf{\bn{বিমা}}, \emph{bimā}.) A guarantee? (\textbf{\bn{গ্যারান্টি}}, \emph{gærānṭi}.) Well protected? (\textbf{\bn{সুরক্ষিত}}, \emph{surôkkhit}.) A fire extinguisher? (\textbf{\bn{অগ্নিনির্বাপক}}, \emph{ôgninirbāpôk}.) A recommendation? (\textbf{\bn{সুপারিশ}}, \emph{supārish}.) Consent? (\textbf{\bn{সম্মতি}}, \emph{sômmôti}.) A kind of thing? (\textbf{\bn{রকম}}, \emph{rôkôm}.) A style? (\textbf{\bn{ধরন}}, \emph{dhôrôn}.) To fit? (\textbf{\bn{খাপ} \bn{খাওয়া}}, \emph{khāp khāoyā}.) To make up one's mind? (\textbf{\bn{মনস্থির} \bn{করা}}, \emph{mônôsthir kôrā}.) With no other choice? (\textbf{\bn{অগত্যা}}, \emph{ôgôtyā}.) Half-willing? (\textbf{\bn{নিমরাজি}}, \emph{nimrāji}.) A commitment? (\textbf{\bn{অঙ্গীকার}}, \emph{ônggīkār}.) To shrink back? (\textbf{\bn{পিছপা} \bn{হওয়া}}, \emph{pichhpā hôoyā}.) A natural disaster? (\textbf{\bn{দুর্যোগ}}, \emph{durjog}.) A calamity? (\textbf{\bn{বিপর্যয়}}, \emph{bipôrjôy}.) On the point of? (\textbf{\bn{উপক্রম}}, \emph{upôkrôm}.) Imminent? (\textbf{\bn{আসন্ন}}, \emph{āsônnô}.) For emergencies? (\textbf{\bn{আপৎকালীন}}, \emph{āpôtkālīn}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
